This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
## 1. Primary Request and Intent

The user has made the following explicit requests throughout the conversation:
- **"continue"** - Continue the FoundryAI project work
- **"Do all the needful systematically without stopping at all from a to z"** - Complete all remaining work without interruption
- **"Work alone until you finish the whole project"** - Work independently, no team members
- **"Wrok alone until you finish the whole project non-stop at all"** - Repeat emphasis on non-stop independent work
- **"help me commit and push to github"** - Set up GitHub remote and push code
- **"I have committed and pushed to git hub but I still getting errors, are you able to help me?"** - User pushed to GitHub but encountering errors
- **"Continue the work"** - Continue fixing the errors

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Next.js 16.2.1** with App Router and Turbopack
- **TypeScript** with strict mode
- **Supabase** for authentication, database, and SSR client management
- **Stripe** for payment processing (webhooks, subscriptions)
- **OpenAI** (GPT-4o-mini) for AI curriculum generation
- **shadcn/ui** component library (built on Radix UI primitives)
- **Tailwind CSS** for styling
- **7-Layer Architecture**: Foundation → Infrastructure → Domain → Logic → Application → Interface Logic → Design System
- **Business Rules Engine**: Pluggable validation system
- **Event Bus**: Typed pub/sub system for domain events
- **Workflow Engine**: Multi-step async workflows with retry/backoff
- **Theme System**: Light/dark mode with ThemeProvider and localStorage persistence

## 3. Files and Code Sections

### Core Infrastructure (already complete - 22 files, ~2,900 lines):
- `src/lib/business-rules-engine/engine.ts` (577 lines) - Validation rules for guides, curriculums, assignments
- `src/lib/business-rules-engine/index.ts` (45 lines) - Re-exports
- `src/lib/event-bus/index.ts` (309 lines) - Typed event pub/sub system
- `src/lib/workflow-engine/engine.ts` (357 lines) - Multi-step async workflows
- `src/lib/workflow-engine/index.ts` (25 lines) - Re-exports
- `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` - Browser Supabase client
- `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` - Server Supabase client (needs `createClient` export)
- `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts` - Middleware Supabase client
- `src/lib/constants.ts` - STRIPE_PLANS, RATE_LIMITS, FEATURES config
- `src/lib/feature-gate.ts` - Feature flag system
- `src/lib/curriculum.ts` - Curriculum utilities (parseDurationToMinutes, calculateCurriculumStats)
- `src/lib/ai.ts` - OpenAI integration (generateCurriculum, generateAssignmentSuggestions, generateQuizQuestions)
- `src/components/ui/theme-provider.tsx` - Theme context provider
- `src/components/ui/theme-toggle.tsx` - Theme toggle button
- `src/middleware.ts` - Auth middleware with route protection

### Auth Pages (6 files):
- `src/app/(auth)/sign-in/page.tsx` - Sign-in page
- `src/app/(auth)/sign-up/page.tsx` - Sign-up page
- `src/app/(auth)/magic-link/page.tsx` - Magic link auth
- `src/app/auth/callback/page.tsx` - OAuth callback
- `src/app/auth/error/page.tsx` - Auth error display
- `src/app/forgot-password/page.tsx` - Password reset

### Shared Components (7 files, created):
- `src/components/shared/sidebar.tsx` - Collapsible role-aware nav
- `src/components/shared/header.tsx` - Top bar with search, theme toggle, avatar dropdown
- `src/components/shared/guide-card.tsx` - Guide card with badges
- `src/components/shared/course-card.tsx` - Course card with progress bar
- `src/components/shared/progress-ring.tsx` - SVG circular progress
- `src/components/shared/empty-state.tsx` - Empty state component
- `src/components/shared/loading-skeleton.tsx` - Skeleton loaders

### Teacher Portal (10 files):
- `src/app/teacher/layout.tsx` - Sidebar + Header layout
- `src/app/teacher/dashboard/page.tsx` - Stats + activity feed
- `src/app/teacher/guides/page.tsx` - Guide list with create/search
- `src/app/teacher/guides/new/page.tsx` - AI guide creation form
- `src/app/teacher/guides/[id]/page.tsx` - Guide detail + curriculum
- `src/app/teacher/courses/page.tsx` - Course list
- `src/app/teacher/courses/[id]/page.tsx` - Course overview
- `src/app/teacher/courses/[id]/curriculum/page.tsx` - Curriculum editor
- `src/app/teacher/courses/[id]/assignments/page.tsx` - Assignments
- `src/app/teacher/settings/page.tsx` - Profile/security/billing

### Student Portal (9 files):
- `src/app/student/layout.tsx` - Student layout
- `src/app/student/dashboard/page.tsx` - Progress stats + streak
- `src/app/student/guides/page.tsx` - Explore guides
- `src/app/student/guides/[id]/page.tsx` - Guide detail + progress
- `src/app/student/assignments/page.tsx` - Assignment list
- `src/app/student/assignments/[id]/page.tsx` - Assignment submission
- `src/app/student/courses/page.tsx` - My courses
- `src/app/student/courses/[id]/page.tsx` - Course content
- `src/app/student/analytics/page.tsx` - Charts + metrics

### Landing Page (6 files + page.tsx):
- `src/components/landing/hero.tsx` - Hero section
- `src/components/landing/features.tsx` - 6 feature cards
- `src/components/landing/pricing.tsx` - 3-tier pricing (uses STRIPE_PLANS)
- `src/components/landing/testimonials.tsx` - 3 testimonials
- `src/components/landing/faq.tsx` - 6 Q&As accordion
- `src/components/landing/cta.tsx` - Final CTA
- `src/app/page.tsx` - Composes all landing sections

### Tests & Docs:
- `__tests__/business-rules.test.ts` - Tests for validateGuide, validateCurriculum, validateAssignment
- `__tests__/event-bus.test.ts` - Tests for emit, on, once
- `__tests__/workflow-engine.test.ts` - Tests for executeWorkflow
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` - 7-layer architecture documentation

### Files Needing Fixes:
- `src/components/ui/select.tsx` - **Missing SelectValue export**
- `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` - **Missing createClient export** (webhook route imports `createClient` from `@/lib/supabase/server`)
- `src/layer-3-data/repositories/index.ts` - **Missing QueryOptions export** (needs to re-export from types.ts)
- `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx` - **Missing** (created but may not have persisted)
- `src/components/ui/alert.tsx` - **Missing** (created but may not have persisted)
- `src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` - **Missing** (created but may not have persisted)
- `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx` - **Missing** (may exist but not confirmed)
- `src/lib/utils.ts` - May be missing `cn` utility

## 4. Errors and Fixes

### Build Errors (from `npm run build` output):
1. **ImportError: Named export "SelectValue" not found** in `src/components/ui/select.tsx`
   - Attempted fix: Edit command to add SelectValue to exports
   - Status: Fix attempted but not confirmed persisted

2. **ImportError: Named export "createClient" not found** in `src/lib/supabase/server.ts`
   - Attempted fix: Edit command to add createClient function export
   - Status: Fix attempted but not confirmed persisted
   - Note: `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts` imports `createClient` from `@/lib/supabase/server`

3. **ImportError: Named export "QueryOptions" not found** in `src/layer-3-data/repositories/index.ts`
   - Attempted fix: Edit command to add QueryOptions type re-export
   - Status: Fix attempted but not confirmed persisted
   - Note: types.ts contains the QueryOptions type definition

4. **Missing @radix-ui/react-accordion** - Required by accordion.tsx
   - Status: May need npm install

5. **Missing @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu** - Required by dropdown-menu.tsx
   - Status: May need npm install

6. **Missing lucide-react** - Required by dropdown-menu.tsx, accordion.tsx
   - Status: May need npm install

7. **ImportError: Module not found "@/lib/utils"** - cn utility missing
   - Status: May need to create src/lib/utils.ts

8. **ImportError: Module not found "@/components/ui/accordion"**
   - Attempted fix: Created accordion.tsx
   - Status: File created but may not have persisted

9. **ImportError: Module not found "@/components/ui/alert"**
   - Attempted fix: Created alert.tsx
   - Status: File created but may not have persisted

10. **ImportError: Module not found "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"**
    - Attempted fix: Created dropdown-menu.tsx
    - Status: File created but may not have persisted

11. **ImportError: Module not found "@/components/ui/textarea"**
    - Status: May already exist (file was found in some checks)

## 5. Problem Solving Progress

### Solved:
- ✅ Core infrastructure (22 files) - business rules, event bus, workflow engine
- ✅ Auth pages (6 files) - sign-in, sign-up, magic link, callback, error, forgot password
- ✅ Shared components (7 files) - sidebar, header, guide-card, course-card, progress-ring, empty-state, loading-skeleton
- ✅ Teacher portal (10 files) - full CRUD for guides, courses, settings
- ✅ Student portal (9 files) - guides, assignments, courses, analytics
- ✅ Landing page (7 files) - hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA
- ✅ Layout integration - ThemeProvider in root layout
- ✅ Tests (3 files) - business rules, event bus, workflow engine
- ✅ Documentation - ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md
- ✅ Git committed and pushed to GitHub

### Still Broken:
- ❌ Build failing with 12+ errors
- ❌ Missing UI component exports (SelectValue, createClient, QueryOptions)
- ❌ Missing UI components (accordion, alert, dropdown-menu, textarea may not have persisted)
- ❌ May need to install missing npm packages (@radix-ui/react-accordion, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, lucide-react)
- ❌ May need to create src/lib/utils.ts with cn function

## 6. All User Messages

1. "continue" - Initial request to continue the FoundryAI project
2. "Do all the needful systematically without stopping at all from a to z" - Complete all work
3. "Work alone until you finish the whole project" - Work independently
4. "Wrok alone until you finish the whole project non-stop at all" - Repeat emphasis on non-stop work
5. "help me commit and push to github" - Set up GitHub and push
6. "I have committed and pushed to git hub but I still getting errors, are you able to help me?" - User pushed but has errors
7. "Continue the work" - Continue fixing errors

## 7. Pending Tasks

1. **Fix select.tsx** - Add SelectValue to exports
2. **Fix server.ts** - Add createClient function export
3. **Fix repositories/index.ts** - Add QueryOptions re-export
4. **Verify/create UI components** - accordion.tsx, alert.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx, textarea.tsx
5. **Verify/create src/lib/utils.ts** - cn utility function
6. **Install missing npm packages** - @radix-ui/react-accordion, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, lucide-react (if not already installed)
7. **Run build** - Verify 0 errors
8. **Commit and push fixes** to GitHub

## 8. Current Work

Immediately before this summary, I was attempting to fix the build errors by:
1. Creating missing UI components (accordion.tsx, alert.tsx, dropdown-menu.tsx) using the Write tool
2. Attempting to add missing exports to select.tsx (SelectValue), server.ts (createClient), and repositories/index.ts (QueryOptions) using the Edit tool
3. The Edit commands were not persisting correctly - the files kept reverting to their original state
4. The build showed 272/292 modules compiled with some point, but errors kept reappearing

The last confirmed successful actions were creating the accordion.tsx, alert.tsx, and dropdown-menu.tsx files. The export fixes for select.tsx, server.ts, and repositories/index.ts may not have persisted.

## 9. Suggested Next Step

The user's most recent explicit request was: **"Continue the work"**

The single most logical next step is to:

1. **Verify the current state of the 3 files that need export fixes** by reading them:
   - `src/components/ui/select.tsx`
   - `src/lib/supabase/server.ts`
   - `src/layer-3-data/repositories/index.ts`

2. **Use Write (not Edit) to rewrite these files completely** with the correct exports, since Edit has been failing to persist

3. **Verify all 4 UI components exist** (accordion, alert, dropdown-menu, textarea)

4. **Verify src/lib/utils.ts exists** with the cn function

5. **Run `npm run build`** to confirm 0 errors

6. **Commit and push** the fixes to GitHub

The root cause of the persistent build errors is missing exports in 3 files. Once those are fixed with Write commands (which have been more reliable than Edit), and the UI components are confirmed to exist, the build should pass.
